scientific_integrity: The published unsplit width-height count is explicitly credited; the claimed result is its dynamical square-zero versus stabilized-square refinement. No independent mathematical audit or formal certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Not a theorem about all monotone transformations; the antitone subset is not closed under composition. A primary withdrawn preprint and some older literature were not accessible in complete form. The verifier checks only n <= 9.
scientific_scope: All n >= 1 and all nonempty antitone order-decreasing partial transformations of [n], including noninjective maps; multiplication in ambient monoid.
title: Square-zero and stabilized-square census for order-reversing decreasing partial maps
